# 2K Car Care Vijayawada – Complete Business Information

## About Us
2K Car Care Vijayawada is Vijayawada's premier car care specialists since 2015. Our expert team is certified in 2K paints, Glasurit premium paints, ceramic coating, graphene coating, and specialized wash techniques. We've served 5000+ satisfied customers across all 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh, plus Telangana and Karnataka.

## Complete Service Menu

### 1. Denting & Body Work
Precision dent removal that brings your car's body panels back to their original shape — no filler shortcuts. Our technicians use professional tools to restore panels to factory condition.

### 2. Car Painting Services
**Full Body Paint** – Complete exterior repaint with premium automotive paint for a brand-new showroom finish.
**Body Round Paint** – All-around body panel painting ensuring consistent colour and finish.
**Full Dismantle & Paint** – Complete dismantling of body panels for deep, factory-level paint job with zero overspray.
**Colour Change** – Transform your car's look entirely with a full colour change.
**Dual Tone Colour** – Stylish two-tone paint combinations for a unique custom appearance.
**Dechrome** – Replace shiny chrome trims with sleek blacked-out or body-coloured finish.
**Alloy Wheels Paint** – Precision alloy wheel painting in any colour or finish.
**Calipers Paint** – High-heat brake caliper painting in vibrant colours.
**Interior Custom Paint** – Custom paint on interior trims, dashboards, and panels.
**Matt Finish Paint** – Sophisticated matte paint finish for a stealthy, premium look.
**Outer Cladding Paint** – Paint or restore exterior plastic claddings.
**Footboard Stone Guard** – Protective stone guard coating on footboards and lower panels.
**QRS (Quick Repair Service)** – Fast spot repairs for minor scratches, dents, and paint chips.

### 3. Coating Services
- **Nano Coat** – 6-12 months protection, entry-level option
- **Ceramic Coat (9H)** – 3-5 years protection, most popular service, hydrophobic, UV resistant
- **Graphene Coat** – 5-7 years protection, superior hardness and heat resistance
- **Teflon Coating** – Protection from minor abrasions and environmental damage

### 4. Detailing Services
- **Rubbing & Polish** – Machine polishing eliminates swirl marks and light scratches
- **Interior Detailing** – Deep cleaning, steam treatment, leather conditioning
- **Water Wash** – Thorough exterior water wash

### 5. Protection Services
- **Underbody Anti-Rust** – Heavy-duty coating shields chassis from rust and corrosion
- **Glass Cooling Film** – Premium window films block heat and UV rays

### 6. Accessories
Quality seat covers, mats, organizers, and more.

### 7. Customization
Full-body custom colour wraps and paint jobs for a unique, personalized look.

## Car Wash Maintenance Packages

### Express Foam Wash (Basic)
- Pre-rinse with soft water
- pH-neutral snow foam application
- Hand wash with microfiber mitts
- Wheel & tire cleaning
- Air-dry & microfiber finish

### Premium Full Clean (Popular)
Everything in Express Foam Wash PLUS:
- Interior vacuuming & dusting
- Dashboard & console polish
- Glass cleaning (inside & out)
- Tire dressing & air freshener

### Ceramic Maintenance Wash (Coated Cars)
- Coating-safe pH-neutral shampoo
- Two-bucket wash method
- Iron fallout remover (if needed)
- Ceramic booster spray application
- Soft microfiber drying towels

### Graphene & PPF Safe Wash (Premium)
- Touchless pre-soak option
- PPF/Graphene-safe chemicals only
- Decontamination wash
- Interior steam cleaning
- Full inspection & coating health check

## Premium Paints We Use

### 2K Paints (Nexa Autocolor)
2K (two-component) paint is a professional-grade automotive paint system that uses a hardener mixed with the base coat. This creates a chemical reaction producing a much harder, more durable finish compared to regular 1K paints.

**Benefits:**
- 2-3x longer lasting than conventional paints
- Superior UV resistance prevents fading
- Excellent chemical and scratch resistance
- Maintains gloss for years

**Best for:** Standard professional-grade finishes, everyday vehicles, budget-conscious customers

**Official Website:** https://www.nexaautocolor.com/en-GB

### Glasurit Premium Paints
Glasurit is a premium automotive paint brand manufactured in both Germany and France, part of the BASF Coatings group. It's considered one of the world's finest car paint systems, used by luxury car manufacturers like Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Porsche.

**Benefits:**
- Exceptional color accuracy and matching
- Superior durability and weather resistance
- Mirror-like finish with deep gloss
- Used by Mercedes, BMW, Porsche
- Manufactured in Germany & France

**Best for:** Luxury vehicles, show cars, customers who want absolute best quality

**Official Website:** https://www.glasurit.com/en-int

## Detailed FAQ

**Q: What is the difference between 2K paint and regular paint?**
A: 2K paint (two-component paint) is a professional-grade automotive paint that uses a hardener mixed with the base coat. This creates a chemical reaction that produces a much harder, more durable finish compared to regular 1K paints. At 2K Car Care Vijayawada, we exclusively use 2K paints because they offer superior UV resistance, chemical resistance, and longevity. The finish lasts 2-3 times longer than conventional paints and maintains its gloss for years.

**Q: What is Glasurit paint and why is it premium?**
A: Glasurit is a premium automotive paint brand manufactured in both Germany and France, part of the BASF Coatings group. It's considered one of the world's finest car paint systems, used by luxury car manufacturers like Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and Porsche. Glasurit paints offer exceptional color accuracy, superior durability, excellent weather resistance, and a mirror-like finish.

**Q: What type of paints does 2K Car Care Vijayawada use?**
A: We use two types of premium paints: 2K (two-component) paints for standard professional-grade finishes, and Glasurit premium paints (manufactured in Germany and France) for customers who want the highest quality. Both offer superior durability, color accuracy, and longevity compared to regular paints.

**Q: What car wash maintenance packages do you offer?**
A: We offer four specialized wash packages: 1) Express Foam Wash for quick exterior cleaning, 2) Premium Interior + Exterior Wash for a complete deep clean, 3) Ceramic Maintenance Wash using pH-neutral shampoos safe for coated cars, and 4) Graphene/PPF Safe Wash which is an ultra-gentle, touchless or microfiber-only wash designed to protect your premium coatings.

**Q: What is the best ceramic coating for cars in Vijayawada?**
A: At 2K Car Care Vijayawada, we use professional-grade 9H ceramic coatings that last 3-5 years. Our ceramic coating provides superior hydrophobic protection, UV resistance, and a mirror-like gloss finish. We also offer graphene coating for customers who want even more durability and heat resistance.

**Q: How much does car painting cost in Vijayawada?**
A: Car painting costs vary based on paint type (2K or Glasurit), car size, and finish. At 2K Car Care, we offer transparent pricing with no hidden charges. Contact us at +91 85199 57776 for a free quote tailored to your vehicle.

**Q: Is graphene coating better than ceramic coating?**
A: Graphene coating is the next generation of paint protection. While ceramic coating lasts 3-5 years, graphene coating can last 5-7 years with superior hardness, better heat resistance, and an even deeper mirror gloss. Both are excellent choices.

**Q: How long does ceramic coating last on a car?**
A: Professional ceramic coating applied by our certified experts lasts between 3 to 5 years with proper maintenance. The longevity depends on factors like washing frequency, parking conditions, and climate.

**Q: Do customers from other states visit 2K Car Care?**
A: Yes! While most customers are from Vijayawada and nearby areas in Andhra Pradesh, we regularly serve car owners from Telangana (especially Hyderabad, Warangal, and Nizamabad) and Karnataka (especially Bangalore, Mysore, and Raichur). Many drive 3-5 hours for our quality service.

**Q: Which districts of Andhra Pradesh do you serve?**
A: We proudly serve customers from all 26 districts of Andhra Pradesh — Coastal Andhra, Rayalaseema, and all new districts formed in 2022.

**Q: How long does ceramic coating take?**
A: Ceramic coating typically takes 2-3 days depending on your car's condition and the level of paint correction needed. The coating itself cures within 24-48 hours.

**Q: Do you offer warranty on your services?**
A: Yes! All our coating services come with a written warranty. Ceramic coatings are covered for 3-5 years, graphene coatings for 5-7 years, and paint jobs have comprehensive coverage.

**Q: What are your working hours and where are you located?**
A: We're open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM, and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're located at GP54+728 Plot No. 267, New Autonagar, Kanuru, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 520007.

**Q: Can I book an appointment online?**
A: You can book by calling +91 85199 57776 or messaging us on WhatsApp. We also accept walk-ins during working hours.
